$comment: One Dark, after Atom's theme of that name. Its palette: mono-1 #abb2bf (text), mono-2 #828997, mono-3 #5c6370, cyan #56b6c2, blue #61afef, purple #c678dd, green #98c379, red #e06c75, orange #d19a66, yellow #e5c07b, with #2c313c and #3e4451 for backgrounds. The terminal's own background stays; One Dark's is #282c34.

styles.title: color: var(--blue); font-weight: bold
styles.heading: color: var(--red); font-weight: bold
styles.user-message: color: var(--mono-1); font-weight: bold; background-color: var(--line)
styles.selected: color: var(--blue); font-weight: bold; background-color: var(--selection)
